subject: Multitab application , different tasks for different tabs

messages.author: 8d587ec0858ae795
messages.subject: Multitab application , different tasks for different tabs
parts:
Dear All,
I am working on a shiny app based in navbarPage layout.
My data has the form:

name frequency  year

A           10          2011
B           20          2012
C           10          2013
D           20          2011
E           30          2011
F           40          2012
My code: 

ui.R
library(shiny)
library(shinythemes)
data <- read.csv(file="./Data/data1.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",",encoding = "UTF-8", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
shinyUI(navbarPage(theme = shinytheme("cerulean"),
  
  title = 'MyApp',
  tabPanel('Show Name',     dataTableOutput('ex1')),
  tabPanel('Histogram',  plotOutput("ex2")), 


server.R

library(shiny)
library(datasets)
library(ggplot2)

data <- read.table("./data/data.txt", header=TRUE, sep=",", na.strings="NA", dec=".", strip.white=TRUE)
colnames(data)[1] <- "name"
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  # display 10 rows initially
  output$ex1 <- renderDataTable(data, options = list(pageLength = 10))
  
  # -1 means no pagination; the 2nd element contains menu labels
  output$ex2 <- renderPlot({
    g <- ggplot(data, aes(...) + geom_bar(stat="identity")
    print(g)
  })


In the first tab I just filter dataset and it is working fine.
In the second tab  to enter name and to build a histogram showing this name frequency for the years 2011, 2012 or others as in data

How to make this possible
Regards

messages.author: c32fddd40a70e5ac
messages.subject: Re: Multitab application , different tasks for different tabs
parts:
Hi Endri

Your second tab is not an histogram, it's a bar graph. To select a specific date to plot you could use a selectInput (http://shiny.rstudio.com/reference/shiny/latest/selectInput.html).

martin
